name: Pigeon Cay Beach Club
brand_truth: Eight handmade cottages on a private, quiet north Cat Island beach where the honor bar and the kayaks are yours.

design.signature: Stay estimator from published rates, taxes, meals and taxi

current_site_findings: All eight cottages, rates and galleries are on one very long page; on a phone the price you want is far down.
The homepage repeats the same guest reviews several times, many with no text.
No deposit and payment on departure, your best reassurance, is hidden at the bottom.
Meal prices, taxes and the taxi fare are in pop-ups, so nobody sees what a week costs.
The Special Packages section is a wall of terms that buries the offer.
pitch_line: Guests want to know what a week at Pigeon Cay really costs; this site tells them in ten seconds, with your own rates, and puts no deposit next to every booking button.
assumptions: Estimator applies VAT and resort levy to lodging only and 15% gratuity to meals
Dinner limited to four per week (Wed-Sat)
Photo choices for the 'Days here' section are illustrative picks from their galleries
notes: Record said no own site, but pigeoncaybahamas.com is live (refreshed 2026); built as Track A redesign. Rates as published on their site in Nov 2026: confirm current. Hosts named in a guest review (Ned and Leslie) not used. Photos hotlinked from their site; crops not visible in sandbox. interact.mjs on index timed out (likely Playwright waiting on the continuously drifting filmstrip links); cottages and weddings pages passed with 0 errors. Same island as Greenwood Beach Resort (also in this repo): designs deliberately unrelated.
